title: Amended supplies under section 9(5) to unregistered persons - 15A

fields.description: Month being amended, spelled out in capitals.
Place of supply as 'NN-Name'; only the numeric prefix is kept.
Combined tax rate for this line, in percent.
Corrected taxable value at this rate.
Cess on this line. Must be an explicit 0 when there is none — see the quirk note.

keys.description: 'INTER' or 'INTRA', from the place of supply against the filer's own state.
Stamped on every e-commerce record; no column supplies it.
The supplier again. The reference writes the same registration under two keys; there is no separate original-supplier column.

derivation_notes.gstr1.supply_type: 'INTRA' when the place of supply is the filer's own state and the filer is not an SEZ unit.
derivation_notes.gstr1.tax_split_by_pos: Intra-state: camt = samt = round(txval * rt * 0.005, 2). Inter-state: iamt = round(txval * rt * 0.01, 2).
derivation_notes.gstr1.cess: csamt = round(Cess Amount, 2), or 0 when blank.
derivation_notes.gstr1.original_period: omon = the MMYYYY period named by the financial year and the spelled-out original month.

notes.text: A BLANK CESS AMOUNT IS REPORTED AS A MISSING HEADER COLUMN — the presence check reads the parsed ROW, and blank cells are omitted by the reader. Every row needs an explicit 0. This implementation defaults a blank to 0 instead.
Every record carries flag: "N", written unconditionally with no column behind it.
A SUPPLIER GSTIN EQUAL TO THE FILER'S OWN SILENTLY DROPS THE ROW, with a clean import report and no error anywhere. This implementation rejects it so the loss is visible.

The only section in the return that nests under 'posItms': the envelope groups by place of supply, and each entry holds the amended supplies for one supplier and period, which in turn hold the line items. Items here are BARE — no num and no itm_det wrapper — with the rate before the taxable value.
'ostin' repeats the value of 'stin'. The template has no original-supplier column, so an incorrectly reported supplier cannot actually be amended here; the key exists but can never differ.
